author: Andrea Volpato
modification: Antitone evaluates and factors the nonspatial model, calibrates print time on neutral0.18 toY0.1, adds a brightness-anchored convex reference-negative spectral adapter with boundary-only radial mapping and inverse authoring DRT; no photographic fitting. Spektrafilm data derivatives CC BY-SA4.0; native algorithm ports GPLv3. Historical Academy reference-derived components are a private trial with separate unresolved public redistribution clearance.

reference_source.reference: S-2008-002 v1.1, November 18, 2010; APD and ADX gains (1, .92, .95)
reference_source.prior_and_Dmin: kodak_vision3_250d base; no negative characteristic curves
reference_source.selector: Minimum relative entropy of summed APD-action distribution at fixed flux ratios; canonical mass fixes total flux.
reference_source.receiver: TH-KG3; positive relative-filter interpolation with held endpoints, opaque outside supplied common negative support.
reference_source.scale: Canonical transmission may exceed one. Passive-filter/common-printer-exposure representation is an output-invariant gauge, not identical fixed-scale filter APD readings.
reference_source.distribution: Private trial; public redistribution permission for APD reference data remains unestablished.

kodak_supra_endura.intent: The historical Academy universal density reference supplies flux constraints for a minimum-relative-entropy spectrum with an explicit base prior. Adapter-only boundary projection and low-positive receiver continuation retain signed AP1 upstream. Original scalar gray tone/tint and common-Y anchoring remain; no output hue/saturation fit or named film characteristic curve.

kodak_supra_endura.exposure_calibration: Fixed sRGB reference; output finishing does not rebalance exposure.
